visual_identity.value: The visual identity features Coca-Cola red paired with white Spencerian script, contour bottles, and glasses filled with ice and condensation. It emphasizes fresh, ice-cold refreshment combined with meals, togetherness, and music.
visual_identity.source: ai-direction (derived from the checked facts, not a brand rule)

ad_look.value: Coca-Cola red with white Spencerian script; contour bottle and glasses with ice/condensation; meals and togetherness (food-pairing is the core India platform), celebrities (Diljit Dosanjh, Janhvi Kapoor; Tiger Shroff for Zero Sugar with black cues), music via Coke Studio Bharat. Warm, upbeat, emotional tone.
